subject: Coordinating discovery with engineering, security, and procurement — IonWave
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <m.singh@ionwave.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Redwood x IonWave — Discovery & stakeholders

Hi Maya —

Great to meet you at the product overview yesterday. I want to get a short discovery on the calendar so we can align technical owners (eng + security) and procurement up front. That will help us scope the Dedicated/Private options and surface any compliance questions early.

Proposed 30–45 min windows (PST):
- Tue May 4 — 10:00–10:45
- Tue May 4 — 15:00–15:45
- Wed May 5 — 08:30–09:15

If none of those work, please send 2–3 alternative slots and include whoever on your side should join (engineering lead, security/compliance, procurement).

Attached is a one-page agenda (Discovery-Agenda-v1.pdf) so folks know the focus: 1) goals & constraints 2) current infra & data flow 3) initial SLOs/throughput 4) next steps/procurement.

Sean (SE) and Marcus (platform lead) are cc’d — can you confirm who from our side should cover security & deployment questions?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Discovery-Agenda-v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Maya Singh <m.singh@ionwave.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood x IonWave — Discovery & stakeholders

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks — Tuesday May 4th is looking tight for our engineering lead. A couple of options that work for us (PST):
- Wed May 5 — 09:30–10:00
- Thu May 6 — 11:00–11:45

I'll loop in procurement and security so we get the right people: Carlos Ruiz (procurement) and Priya Narayanan (security/compliance). Priya will want a short pre-read on data residency and audit logging. Carlos also asked if we could surface standard T&C timelines and any required onboarding docs — happy to share his email (c.ruiz@ionwave.com) so he can get the DocuSign/PO process started.

Also — would an SE deep-dive slide or a short architecture sketch help Priya prepare? If so, we can ask Marcus to include that.

Best,
Maya
Senior Product Manager, IonWave Systems
Maya.Singh@ionwave.com

Hi Maya / Kim —

Thanks for the context — happy to join. I can do Wed May 5 09:30–10:00 PST. I’ll prepare a two-slide architecture + deployment note that highlights: model routing options, KV cache constraints, and where audit logs can be surfaced for SOC-type requests. Marcus will cover quantization and Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs in the same call.

Priya — if you want a separate 20-min technical sync just on audit/logging after the discovery, we can schedule that the same week. I can share the redwood-security-brief.pdf ahead of time.

Kimberly — can you send a calendar invite and include a brief agenda and the HubSpot record?

Maya / Carlos / Priya —

Thanks for moving quickly on this. Wed May 5, 09:30–10:00 PST is confirmed. I’ve created a calendar invite and included the short agenda and a HubSpot link to notes.

Call details:
- Calendar event: May 5, 2027 — 09:30 PT / 12:30 ET (30 min)
- Join: https://meet.redwood.ai/j/459-IONWAVE (passcode on invite)
- Agenda: roll call, goals & constraints (10m), infra & security questions (10m), procurement next steps (10m)

Attachments: redwood-security-brief.pdf (high-level pre-read — Priya), Discovery-Agenda-v1.pdf

Carlos — I included your email on the invite and added a short note about procurement deliverables (PO process, typical onboarding timeline). If you prefer, I can CC finance@redwood.ai to speed the PO routing.

If anyone needs to move, please reply with an alternate slot and I’ll re-run availability. Otherwise, looking forward to the conversation.
